title: Live schema changes and backfills
brief: Change a schema through compatible states while callers and existing rows keep changing.
outcomes: Design expand, migrate and contract around real callers
Prove a backfill converged despite races and late rows
entry: Constraints, application transactions and bulk changes.

neighbours.RL119: Owns PostgreSQL locks and index changes.

heading.title: Two application versions
heading.brief: Use a proposed money-representation change on order lines; enumerate what old and new callers read and write at each transition.

heading.title: A bounded schema operation
heading.brief: Distinguish metadata changes, validation, table rewrites and index builds; budget waits and cancellation rather than promising universal online DDL.

nested_article.title: PostgreSQL schema changes under load
nested_article.brief: Carry out compatible PostgreSQL schema and index changes with bounded waits and complete acceptance.
outcomes: Choose native operations from their lock and rewrite behaviour
Validate backfill convergence and maintain indexes safely
nested_article.entry: General schema-change protocol, PostgreSQL indexes and locking.

heading.title: A backfill that converges
heading.brief: Use idempotent batches and a write capture rule; insert a late row behind the cursor and prove a final reconciliation catches it.

nested_article.title: CockroachDB schema jobs under load
nested_article.brief: Treat CockroachDB schema changes as observable jobs within an application compatibility protocol.
outcomes: Interpret job progress, failure and cleanup
Accept a backfill or unique index only after semantic checks
nested_article.entry: General schema migration, constraints and CockroachDB architecture.

heading.title: Contraction and rollback
heading.brief: Validate meaningful value equivalence, switch readers, retire old writers and remove old representation only after the reversal boundary is understood.
